crossRefs.note: Then the captain on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, “Behold, if Yahweh made windows in…
The disciples said to him, “Where should we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”
But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth…
His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”
Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”
Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”
He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive…
“There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

translations.web: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”
translations.bsb: If all our flocks and herds were slaughtered for them, would they have enough? Or if all the fish in the sea were caught for them, would they have enough?”
translations.kjv: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice
translations.asv: Shall flocks and herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
